integration_issues.flow: Impor Laporan Pencairan - store auto-selection on a SECOND import
integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL/HIGH. In FinanceSettlementModule.jsx importFile(): `const f = { ...EMPTY, account_id: form.account_id || accountId || '' }` followed by `if (!f.account_id && d.platform_guess) {...}`. Because `form` state survives closing the form/import panel, the second and every later import inherits the PREVIOUS import's account_id and the platform-based auto-pick is skipped entirely. Reproduced twice: (1) import Shopee CSV, close form, import TikTok XLSX -> store stays 'DA Official Shopee', pressing Simpan saved STM-2026-08-16-01 (a tiktokshop report) under DA Official Shopee (verified in Mongo: account_id=c386b3ce... platform=shopee). (2) reverse order: import TikTok first, then Shopee CSV -> store stays 'DA Official TikTok'. Nothing on screen warns that the store contradicts platform_guess. Consequence: wrong per-store deduction cards and, once journaled, the wrong coa_cash_code/coa_revenue_code (the exact failure mode the module docstring says it must prevent). Fix: derive the account from d.platform_guess on EVERY import (reset form to EMPTY first, or only keep a MANUALLY chosen account), and/or block save + show a warning when accOf(form.account_id).platform !== d.platform_guess.

critical_code_review_comments: FinanceSettlementModule.jsx importFile(): `account_id: form.account_id || accountId || ''` conflates 'user's deliberate choice' with 'leftover state from the previous import'. Since the auto-pick is gated on `!f.account_id`, this permanently disables platform detection after the first import. Reset to EMPTY (or track a separate `accountTouchedByUser` flag) before applying the draft.

settlement_import.py values(): every field except `adjustments` is passed through abs(). A platform that reports gross_sales as a negative correction would be silently flipped positive. Acceptable today, but worth logging when sign flipping occurs.

/import/preview validates the extension only after reading the whole body; the 15 MB guard runs after `await file.read()`, so a 500 MB upload is still fully buffered in memory before rejection. Consider streaming/size-checking earlier.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the wrong-store import: React state `form` is module-level and is never reset between imports. `importFile()` seeds the new draft with `form.account_id || accountId` and then only auto-detects the store when that seed is empty (`if (!f.account_id && d.platform_guess)`). After the first import the seed is never empty again, so `platform_guess` is ignored for all subsequent imports in the same page session. Reproduction: fresh load -> import Shopee CSV (store correctly = DA Official Shopee) -> close form -> import TikTok XLSX -> store still DA Official Shopee -> Simpan -> Mongo doc for STM-2026-08-16-01 has account_id=c386b3ce-2b85-453a-88a3-b3e5e37277be / platform=shopee. Mitigation until fixed: reload the page before each import, or manually re-pick the store in fin-settlement-input-account.
